decision_rule: These numbers are recorded so the record can be read. None of them may enter any decision, and none of them is compared against any threshold.
metric: Held-out fit quality of the pooled nine-width probe, read several ways, so an out-of-band anchor can be told apart from a mismatch between two different fits.
notes: The anchor statistic fits and scores at width 140 alone, which is the design's own reading. The other readings here exist so a reader can see whether an out-of-band anchor means the instrument drifted or means the band's centre belongs to a different fit. None of them decides anything. A further run of this script on the same box is a rerun of the same instrument, not a replication.

values.run_void_reason: the anchor gate failed: held-out fit quality 0.859740 falls outside the measured band 0.767394 to 0.794606, so every result this run produces is an instrument fault and is not evidence about the model
